# Average Salary Excluding the Minimum and Maximum Salary. compare defaults
# to float 1e-5 for a double.

@example Leave out 1500 and 9800; the average of 4200 and 3100 is 3650.
[4200,1500,9800,3100]
=> 3650.0

@example With three salaries, only the middle one is left.
[2000,5000,3000]
=> 3000.0

@example Leave out 1000 and 8000; 2000, 4000 and 7000 add up to 13000, and 13000 / 3 is not a whole number.
[1000,2000,4000,8000,7000]
=> 4333.333333333333

# The smallest input, with salaries at both bounds.
[1000,1000000,500000]
=> 500000.0

# The lowest and the highest salary side by side at the front.
[1000,1000000,2000,3000]
=> 2500.0

# The highest salary first and the lowest last.
[1000000,4000,5000,1000]
=> 4500.0

# The lowest and the highest salary side by side at the end.
[6000,7000,1001,999000]
=> 6500.0

# An average that ends in .5.
[1000,3000,4001,999999]
=> 3500.5

# A repeating decimal: 3007 / 3.
[1002,2000,1001,1000,1004]
=> 1002.3333333333334

# Sorted in decreasing order.
[9000,8000,7000,6000,5000]
=> 7000.0

# Sorted in increasing order, the lowest salary above 1000.
[1500,2500,3500,4500,5500,6500]
=> 4000.0

# 100 salaries, the 100 largest allowed (999901 to 10^6) in random order.
[999934,999926,1000000,999985,999979,999982,999922,999994,999983,999902,999923,999901,999962,999974,999925,999950,999927,999945,999977,999980,999948,999903,999952,999939,999915,999949,999911,999933,999917,999995,999966,999970,999943,999960,999989,999999,999967,999992,999958,999930,999921,999988,999935,999961,999932,999914,999964,999904,999957,999987,999946,999963,999959,999924,999993,999941,999937,999968,999972,999981,999944,999953,999936,999940,999976,999919,999997,999938,999918,999906,999991,999996,999998,999978,999929,999916,999973,999990,999955,999971,999986,999931,999909,999954,999956,999912,999905,999928,999965,999908,999975,999947,999913,999969,999910,999907,999984,999951,999920,999942]
=> 999950.5

# Random small cases from gen.c (lc check --regen makes them).
@gen 1 small
[1008,1009,1001,1004,1011]
=> 1007.0

@gen 2 small
[999985,999993,999997,999989,999987,999998,999994]
=> 999992.0

@gen 3 small
[1000,1014,1012,1003,1009,1013,1010,1001]
=> 1008.0

@gen 4 small
[1013,1000,1014,1005]
=> 1009.0

@gen 5 small
[1005,1010,1011,1007,1006,1014]
=> 1008.5

@gen 6 small
[1002,1001,1007,1004,1011,1000]
=> 1003.5
